newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish police find illegal cache of Soviet arms.
newsitem.headline: Polish police find illegal cache of Soviet arms.

text.p: Polish police have arrested four men after uncovering a cache of Soviet-made weapons, including rocket launchers, in the southern city of Czestochowa, a police spokesman said on Monday.
The men were suspected of supplying gangsters and poachers with weapons, PAP news agency reported local police spokesman Marian Kotarski as saying.
A fifth suspect was granted bail due to poor health, the agency added.
Television showed pictures of the arms cache which included land mines, grenades and a wide variety of rifles, handguns, bayonets, ammunition, explosives and detonators.
Kotarski said the arms included a launcher for self-guided missiles and a RPG-76 armour-piercing rocket launcher.
If convicted, the men could face jail terms of up to 10 years, the television said.
The arms were left behind by Russian soldiers in the early 1990s or smuggled into Poland, it added.
